$comment: Per-section spec.json — the distilled, checkable must_haves for one Figma section node. Produced during Research (verbatim from get_design_context, NEVER rounded). Single source of truth for plan, build, and goal-backward verify. Lives at extraction/figma/sections/<key>/spec.json. See SKILL.md 'Per-Section Build & Verify Loop' and VERIFY_HARNESS.md.
$comment_spacing: Exact px from get_design_context. Build matches these; map to a token only if the token equals the value, else add a token or use the literal. Never snap to nearest.
structure: Split header + quadrant: 4 corner cards around a centered product image. NOTE: middle-top card is opacity-0 (a spacer reserving the center column).
gotchas: Band override flips eyebrow/title/text to inverse — re-assert the intended color in THIS band.
Center column is reserved by an invisible (opacity-0) card in Figma.
$comment_breakpoints: 375 is its OWN spec, not desktop-reflowed. Capture mobile padding/stacking/type from the mobile Figma node.
$comment_editability: Every text/image below MUST map to a setting with the Figma value as default (Theme-Editor Wiring Audit).

editable.default: Better snacking starts with better standards.

$comment_checks: Fed verbatim to window.F2S_SPEC.checks for f2s_measure.py. prop = CSS computed property OR derived metric (box.width|box.height|gap-to-right|lines).

breakpoints_designed.mobile: <actual designed width, e.g. 430 — read from the frame, NEVER assumed 375>

annotations: <EVERY designer note harvested from annotation frames / dev-mode notes near this node — anything not listed here does not exist downstream. Verifier checks each off.>
